description: Task 14: Implement autonomous Counter test-provider checkout orchestrator. Compose the full checkout workflow: signed mandate/intent, policy decision, Shopify draft order, deterministic test payment via CounterTestPaymentProvider, continuation decision, Shopify finalization, reconciliation, and receipt. Enforce state-by-state amount/rolling reservation accounting and attempt-count limits from PILOT.md (INR 5000 per tx, INR 10000 rolling 24h, 5 attempts per 24h). Hard-bind test authorization/provider to non-live environments. Revalidate authority, revocation, policy, quote/draft binding, kill switches before finalization.
steps: Create packages/payment-sdk/src/checkout-orchestrator.ts implementing a CheckoutOrchestrator class that composes the full autonomous checkout flow: (1) validate mandate/intent signatures and bindings, (2) evaluate policy decision via merchant-policy compiler, (3) create Shopify draft order via DraftOrderCreateAction pattern, (4) execute payment via CounterTestPaymentProvider.createInstruction(), (5) verify payment evidence, (6) revalidate authority/policy/kill-switches, (7) finalize Shopify order via OrderFinalizeAction, (8) reconcile via evidence package reconcileTransaction, (9) issue receipt via issueReceipt

Create packages/payment-sdk/src/checkout-limits.ts implementing rolling amount/attempt accounting: (a) TransactionLedger interface tracking 24h rolling totals per wallet, (b) InMemoryTransactionLedger implementation, (c) enforceTransactionLimits() checking PILOT.md caps (5000 INR per tx, 10000 rolling 24h, 5 attempts/24h), (d) recordAttempt() for post-execution accounting

Create packages/payment-sdk/src/checkout-types.ts with CheckoutCommand, CheckoutResult (success/declined/review_required/indeterminate), CheckoutPhase enum (mandate_validation, policy_check, draft_creation, payment_execution, continuation_gate, finalization, reconciliation, receipt), KillSwitchPort interface
Create packages/payment-sdk/src/kill-switch.ts with KillSwitchEvaluator that checks merchant/wallet/global kill switches before finalization, InMemoryKillSwitchStore, KillSwitchStatus type

Add environment binding enforcement: extend assertTestEnvironment and rejectTestAuthorizationInLive to be called at orchestrator construction and before every external effect. Throw ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH if test authorization enters sandbox/pilot/production

Create packages/payment-sdk/src/checkout-orchestrator.test.ts with comprehensive tests: (1) successful end-to-end checkout, (2) policy denial stops before payment, (3) kill switch blocks finalization, (4) expired mandate rejection, (5) revoked authorization rejection, (6) amount limit breach, (7) rolling total exceeded, (8) attempt count exceeded, (9) stale quote/draft binding detection, (10) duplicate idempotent replay, (11) indeterminate payment handling, (12) declined payment handling, (13) compensation on post-payment finalization failure
Update packages/payment-sdk/src/index.ts to export new modules: checkout-orchestrator, checkout-types, checkout-limits, kill-switch
acceptance_criteria: CheckoutOrchestrator successfully composes full checkout flow: mandate -> policy -> draft -> payment -> verify -> finalize -> reconcile -> receipt
Test authorization is hard-bound to non-live environments (local/test only); ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH thrown otherwise
Transaction limits enforced: per-tx INR 5000, rolling 24h INR 10000, 5 attempts per wallet per 24h
Kill switch check occurs before finalization and blocks if active
All revalidation gates (authority, policy, quote binding) are checked before finalization
Duplicate checkout commands with same idempotency key produce at most one effect
